feature.name: proforma-json

remaining_scope: Modification resolution and AASequence conversion with policies/issues.
preserved_source_quirks: All chain charges and ion name transported in JSON, unlike text omission paths.
resolved_mod is ignored on write and reset None on every read.
Missing global_mods defaults empty; other five chain vectors and ion chains required. Optional nulls reset None; omitted is_chimeric and position flags false, explicit null booleans error.
Modifications, glycan components and global locations use generic iteration: lexical object values, null empty, scalar one. Typed vectors require arrays.
Unknown keys ignored, duplicate keys last wins, case-sensitive variant and enum strings.
i32 fields accept boolean1/0 and truncate floats; double fields reject bool; bool fields reject numeric inputs.
LeadingUTF8BOM accepted; bare integer-0 normalized to0 while decimal/exponent negativezero and quotedtext are retained.
No text parsing, chemistry lookup, cross-link validation or inferred resolved records during JSON decode.
native_differences: Explicit finite-write requirement instead of nlohmann nonfinite-to-null serialization.
Integer overflow checked rather than implementation-dependent narrowing or undefined float casts.
Individual source byte-char fields accept ASCII includingNUL/punctuation; all other String fields preserveUnicode.
Generic crate parse/value errors instead of C++ exception ABI/nlohmann error codes and exact messages.
Semantic compact JSON equivalence with finite float-roundtrip rather than universal exact floating numeric spellings.
Bounded preflight plus shared read/build/output ledgers; whole result only on success.

limits.writer_map_entry_allowance: 1024 + 32 * sizeof((String,serde_json::Value)) per insertedfield, plus owned key/value strings
limits.input_preflight: Raw structural tokens including duplicates/unknowns, depth and conservative input-size*log(itemcount) sorted-map work before serdeDOM allocation. Byte total is requested/logical storage with headroom, not exact physical memory. Standard serde/map allocation remains ordinary Rust allocation inside bounds.
